newsitem.title: UK: Main pipeline to Novorossiisk oil port reopens.
newsitem.headline: Main pipeline to Novorossiisk oil port reopens.

text.p: The main pipeline feeding Russia's oil terminal at Novorossiisk on the Black Sea reopened as expected on Thursday after scheduled repairs were completed, a shipping source said on Friday.
A smaller pipeline reopened early on Wednesday. Combined crude flow to the port on Friday was about 526,000 barrels per day (bpd), the source said.
A crude tanker, the Star Hero, was loading one million barrels of Russian Urals at berth one.
Other Black Sea ports at Odessa and Tuapse were operating normally, as was the Latvian port of Ventspils on the Baltic.
